quote: We provide products to our largest end customer, Apple Inc. ("Apple"), through sales to multiple contract manufacturers, which in the aggregate accounted for 50% and 47% of total revenue in fiscal years 2026 and 2025, respectively.
Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. ("Samsung") accounted for 10% of total revenue in both fiscal years 2026 and 2025.
In fiscal 2025, the Company completed the sale of its assembly and test operations in Beijing and Dezhou to Luxshare Precision Industry Co., Ltd. ("Luxshare").
